metadata.extraction_note: The body is PyMuPDF 1.26.7's text for these pages in content-stream order. The PDF's tagged structure attaches ActualText to some glyphs, and PyMuPDF substitutes it, so the body differs from the printed pages as follows. The word "Bullet" appears 30 times where the page prints a bullet (•). On PDF page 1 the cover title "2025 California Earned Income Tax Credit Booklet. 3514 California Forms & Instructions" appears four times where the page prints it once: three copies on lines of their own, and a fourth that starts at the end of the "Form FTB 3514, California Earned Income Tax Credit" line and ends on the next line. Headings repeat where the page prints them once: the Step 1, 2 and 4 headings twice on one line; the Step 3, 5 and 7 headings three times on one line; on PDF page 5 the Worksheet 2 heading twice on consecutive lines and the Worksheet 1 heading three times (twice on one line, then again on the next line); on PDF page 9 the Part I heading twice and the Part III heading three times on one line; and the Step 8-11 headings twice, with the second copy broken across a line break (mid-word for Steps 8, 10 and 11, between words for Step 9). The Step 7-11 headings and the line 22, 30, 31 and 41 headings spell the credit acronyms with spaces ("E I T C", "Y C T C", "F Y T C") where the page prints EITC, YCTC and FYTC. The pipeline removes and replaces no words: the body keeps every token PyMuPDF 1.26.7 returns for these pages.
metadata.source_note: Official FTB 2025 instructions for form FTB 3514: cover and contents, general information, differences from federal law, Steps 1-5 (filer qualifications, investment income worksheets, qualifying child, filer without a qualifying child, California earned income), Steps 7-11 (part-year resident EITC, Young Child Tax Credit, Foster Youth Tax Credit), and the assistance and privacy pages. Step 6 and the California Earned Income Tax Credit Worksheet (PDF page 8) are retained at us-ca/form/individual-income-tax/2025/3514-eitc-worksheet.
metadata.statutory_note: SB 1435 (Stats. 2026, Ch. 236, Sec. 2), effective September 14, 2026, amended R&TC 17052 for taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2025, which includes the 2025 taxable year this booklet covers. The 17052 record at statutory_corpus_version holds the text from before that amendment, which was in force on the PDF's modification date (February 19, 2026). For taxable year 2025 it is superseded by the amended text in the 17052 record at statutory_superseding_corpus_version. The amendment rewrites 17052(d), (j)(1) and (j)(2).

metadata.extraction_note: The body is PyMuPDF 1.26.7's text for PDF page 8 in content-stream order, and that text differs from the printed page in two ways. The PDF's tagged structure attaches the ActualText "Bullet" to bullet glyphs, and PyMuPDF substitutes it: the three line 5 conditions begin with the word "Bullet" (3 times) where the page prints a bullet (•). The heading "Part III Your Earned Income Tax Credit" appears three times on one line where the page prints it once. The pipeline removes and replaces no words: the body keeps every token PyMuPDF 1.26.7 returns for the page, and the line numbers, stop and skip guards and line 5 thresholds read as printed.
metadata.source_note: Official FTB 2025 Step 6 instructions and California Earned Income Tax Credit Worksheet (booklet page 8). Line 1 stops when California earned income is zero or less; line 2 reads the credit from the EITC Table and stops when that credit is zero; line 4 skips line 5 when line 1 and line 3 are the same; line 5 is left blank when federal AGI on line 3 is less than $4,661, $6,998 or $9,823 for no, one, or two or more qualifying children, and otherwise reads the EITC Table at line 3 so that line 6 takes the smaller of line 5 and line 2. The PDF content stream places the worksheet lines before the Step 6 introduction, and this extraction keeps that stream order.

metadata.extraction_note: The body is PyMuPDF 1.26.7's text for these pages in content-stream order. The PDF's tagged structure attaches ActualText to some glyphs, and PyMuPDF substitutes it, so the body differs from the printed form as follows. The word "Bullet" appears 4 times, all on PDF page 16 (Side 4), where the form prints a hollow sub-bullet (◦). On PDF page 13 the form title "TAXABLE YEAR 2025 California Earned Income Tax CreditFORM 3514" appears five times, each on a line of its own, where the form prints it once, in separately placed pieces. Each Part I-X heading appears twice on one line where the form prints it once. On PDF page 15 the line 23 text ("23. California earned income. Enter the amount from form FTB 3514, line 19. If the amount entered here is greater than $0, do not complete line 23a or line 23b and continue on to line 24") appears twice, the second copy broken across a line break, where the form prints it once. Entry fields, cents boxes and pre-printed amounts follow the content stream rather than sitting beside their line; for example, the 1,189 pre-printed in the line 24 box on PDF page 15 comes right after line 22 in the body. The pipeline removes and replaces no words: the body keeps every token PyMuPDF 1.26.7 returns for these pages.
metadata.source_note: Official 2025 form FTB 3514, Sides 1-4, as printed in the booklet (PDF pages 13-16): Part I qualifying information, Part II investment income, Part III qualifying child information, Part IV California earned income (lines 13-19), Part V California EITC (line 20), and Parts VI-X for the part-year resident EITC, the Young Child Tax Credit and the Foster Youth Tax Credit. Printed line numbers and entry fields follow the PDF content-stream order. The booklet's second copy of the form (PDF pages 17-20) has identical extracted text and is not captured again.

metadata.extraction_note: The body is PyMuPDF 1.26.7's position-sorted text for these pages. The PDF's tagged structure gives the column labels on PDF page 22 ActualText replacement strings (for example "And your number of qualifying children is 0, Your credit is"), and PyMuPDF returns those strings in place of the printed labels, in content-stream order as well. With the position sort PyMuPDF returns 2,410 non-whitespace characters for PDF page 22 against 2,822 in stream order; for PDF pages 23-30 the two orders return the same characters. The page prints two column blocks, each labelled "If the amount you are looking up from the worksheet is . . .", "At least", "But Not Over", "0 1 2 3" and "Your credit is . . .", but the body's page-22 header is three lines, the last two of them run-together fragments, that hold "Your credit" and the labels 0, 1, 2 and 3 once each and "looking up from" and "But Not" not at all. The header on each of PDF pages 23-30 carries those labels once per printed column block. The page-22 table rows are complete; `table_columns` gives the column meanings.
metadata.source_note: Official FTB 2025 Earned Income Tax Credit Table: 658 lookup brackets of $50 from $1 to $32,900, each giving the credit for 0, 1, 2 and 3 qualifying children. The booklet instructions state that the credit increases with each qualifying child up to a maximum of three children.
